compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is part of an app sign-up process for BabyChakra, a platform aimed at healthier and happier moms and babies. The screen features a welcoming message encouraging users to join the community. Users are given two options to sign up: "Connect with Facebook" or "Connect with Google." It is assured that the app will not post without the user's permission. Additionally, there are links to the "Terms of use" and "Privacy policy" at the bottom of the screen. The design includes floral and bird illustrations, creating a friendly and inviting atmosphere.
